import numpy as np

# FY2010-2024 total receipts and total outlays (millions of dollars)
# Source: Monthly Treasury Statement / Treasury Bulletin Table FFO-1 historical series
# FY2024 confirmed by narrative: receipts ~4.92T, outlays ~6.75T, deficit ~1.83T
receipts = {
    2010: 2162724,
    2011: 2303466,
    2012: 2449988,
    2013: 2775103,
    2014: 3021487,
    2015: 3249886,
    2016: 3267963,
    2017: 3316182,
    2018: 3329904,
    2019: 3463364,
    2020: 3421164,
    2021: 4047111,
    2022: 4896119,
    2023: 4439283,
    2024: 4918734,
}
outlays = {
    2010: 3457079,
    2011: 3603059,
    2012: 3536945,
    2013: 3454647,
    2014: 3506284,
    2015: 3691850,
    2016: 3852615,
    2017: 3981633,
    2018: 4109042,
    2019: 4446952,
    2020: 6553609,
    2021: 6822449,
    2022: 6271506,
    2023: 6134316,
    2024: 6751551,
}

years = sorted(receipts.keys())
r = np.array([float(receipts[y]) for y in years])
o = np.array([float(outlays[y]) for y in years])

def hp_filter(y, lam):
    n = len(y)
    I = np.eye(n)
    D = np.zeros((n-2, n))
    for i in range(n-2):
        D[i, i] = 1.0
        D[i, i+1] = -2.0
        D[i, i+2] = 1.0
    A = I + lam * (D.T @ D)
    return np.linalg.solve(A, y)

lam = 100
r_trend = hp_filter(r, lam)
o_trend = hp_filter(o, lam)

idx = years.index(2024)
actual = r[idx] - o[idx]
structural = r_trend[idx] - o_trend[idx]
gap = abs(actual - structural)

a = round(actual)
s = round(structural)
g = round(gap)
print(f"[{a}, {s}, {g}]")
